question: How does the deposition method of sodium fluoride affect the interfacial dipole on organic layers like P3HT and PCBM?
answer: The deposition method of sodium fluoride affects the interfacial dipole on organic layers by altering the outward-facing component of the dipole parallel to the surface normal. Sequential depositions make the dipole more positive for sodium fluoride on P3HT and less positive for sodium fluoride on PCBM. These changes in the interfacial dipole, influenced by the deposition method, may impact charge injection in organic photovoltaic devices.

The paper investigates the chemical and electronic properties of NaF thin films when used as an electron extraction layer in organic photovoltaic devices.
